question: What should be done when the disciple is to be made a son-initiate?
premises: A further stage arises when making a son-initiate.
At that point initiation should be performed.
The Shriratnamala prescribes a blazing form extending from na to pha.
inference: When elevating the disciple to son-initiate status, the guru should perform initiation using the blazing na-to-pha form taught in the Shriratnamala.
uncertainties: The exact referent of nādiphāntāṃ as mantra, syllable series, or power-form is compressed in the verse.
plain_english: When one is to make the disciple a son-initiate, then initiation should be performed; in the Shriratnamala it is taught as the blazing form extending from na to pha.
